purpose: Keep incident lessons as regression cases instead of turning every historical failure into an always-loaded runtime prohibition.

cases.expected_property: Selected RRULE adapter preserves recurring VEVENT and enabled state.

cases.incident: A stale due overwrote a newer verified due
cases.expected_property: Authoritative scheduler/durable state moves monotonically forward; stale follower data cannot overwrite it.

cases.incident: Clock jitter caused a wake to idle instead of work
cases.expected_property: Early/late dispatch alone does not fence safe work.

cases.incident: A local control-plane write failure stopped all work
cases.expected_property: Failure scope is localized; safe independent work remains admissible.

cases.incident: Follower projections lagged authority and were treated as global failure
cases.expected_property: Projection lag is repairable and non-blocking unless it threatens authoritative correctness.

cases.incident: Rules accumulated until control-plane work dominated useful work
cases.expected_property: Hot-path load remains minimal and decision-driven.
